title: EnvironmentProfile
description: A named, saved description of where and how a run's nodes execute (remote-nodes-12). Loaded by mini_ork/remote/environments.py::load_profile and merged over the template via $MINI_ORK_HOME/config/environments/<name>.yaml (live) over $MINI_ORK_ROOT/config/environments/<name>.yaml (template). See kickoff remote-nodes-12-environment-profiles-attempt-2.md.

node.description: A node name from config/nodes.yaml (epic 06). Resolved via select_node; out of scope to enforce here.

image.description: Base image (e.g. python:3.11). May be a content-addressed digest; if a tag, the cache key uses the resolved digest.

setup.description: Shell script that runs once on session start (cached as an image layer).

setup_timeout_s.description: Timeout for the setup script in seconds; default 900 (kickoff requirement 1).

env.description: Non-secret env vars to set. Keys matching *_KEY / *_TOKEN / *_SECRET / *PASSWORD* are rejected at load time (see environments.py::LookalikeSecretError); put those in `secrets` instead.

secrets.description: Names of secrets the run may use. Values come from the operator's secret store in epic 13; this epic only validates NAMES.

network.description: Network level: 'full' uses the default bridge; 'allowlist' creates an internal Docker network and an egress-proxy container that filters to allow_domains.

allow_domains.description: Domains the EGRESS proxy allows when network='allowlist'. Ignored otherwise.

resources.description: Resource limits mapped onto docker run --cpus/--memory (kickoff requirement 5).
